cards.title: MLB - Yankees
cards.recap: Yankees last played on the road against Angels. The result was W 7-3 @ Angels (Sep 1). The Yankees beat the Angels 7-3 after building an early lead and getting steady work from the bullpen. New York got timely hitting, added insurance late, and never gave the lead back. cards.recap: Coke Zero Sugar 400 at Daytona International Speedway on Aug 29. The winner was Ryan Preece. Ryan Preece won after a late-race charge in a dramatic finish at Daytona. Late-race moves shuffled the field and Preece emerged on top in the closing laps. Next: Cook Out Southern 500 - Darlington Raceway (Sep 6).
